title: SWF: streaming sound export (DefineSound + SoundStreamBlock)
description: Improve audio export: currently SoundItem.compressionType='mp3' emits raw MP3 bytes in DefineSound (tag 14) which works for event sounds. Add SoundStreamHead (tag 18) + SoundStreamBlock (tag 19) support for 'stream' sync mode — needed for audio synced to timeline frames. Also fix: DefineSound currently uses compressionType 2 (MP3) for all audio; add compressionType mapping for 'adpcm' (1), 'raw' (0), 'speech' (6). Write 8 tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/sound-stream.test.ts.
